integrity: The global threshold proof uses exact Gaussian covariance, Cauchy-Schwarz, and explicit rational derivative bounds. A standalone script checks symbolic steps and numerical consistency. No external audit or exhaustive publication-priority certification has been conducted.
limitations: The sufficient global cutoff is established at Hurst index 3/4; the analogous general-H expression is necessary only. Interior optimizing times are not classified. No multi-site or adaptive design is covered. Historical-priority assessment remains incomplete.
title: A sharp terminal-sampling noise threshold for the integral of fractional Brownian motion at \(H=3/4\)
